svg.text: One bubble per faction, however many share a cell
The dashed ring is the room the cell has: anchor to the territory edge, measured off the artwork.
Bubbles shrink to fit, down to a floor of 6.5 — past that the ring sits proud rather than becoming unreadable.
room 40.6 — the roomiest cell on the board
room 20.8 — half the cells have at least this
room 13.5 — the ring starts to sit proud
room 9.3 — a sliver; legibility wins over the border
Ring order is fixed and starts at the top: Atreides, Harkonnen, Emperor, Bene Gesserit, Spacing Guild, Fremen. Numbers are force counts.
